value_stream.name: Packaging, Pallet & Returnable Transport Item (RTI) Management

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, SCM/Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-41), Logistics (links to VS-06), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Quality (links to VS-31), Finance (links to VS-17.4)
fields.Trigger: Annual SCM/sustainability planning (links to VS-33.1/VS-25); EPR/regulatory change (links to VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "Packaging Eng/Merchandising define the packaging governance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: standards and modular sizes; operational: governance and audit (W3539)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Standardization-absence risk**: Ad-hoc packaging inflates cost and cube; mitigated by standards and modular sizes
- **Policy-non-compliance risk**: Packaging breaches EPR/brand standards; mitigated by governance and audit (W3539)
System Touchpoints: - Item/packaging master (links to VS-29); merchandising/private label (links to VS-01/VS-41); logistics/cube (links to VS-110/W3541); sustainability (links to VS-25); commodity (links to VS-106); budget (links to VS-33.1)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/SCM set the packaging strategy and standards: packaging policy, standard materials and specs, modular/standardized carton and pallet sizes (to optimize cube links to VS-110/W3541), right-sizing and over-packaging elimination, private-label packaging standards (links to VS-41), and brand/graphics requirements (links to VS-14); align to sustainability (links to VS-25) and EPR obligations (W3526)

Packaging Eng/Merchandising define the packaging governance: who specifies/approves packaging (vendor vs BuildRight for private label), change-control, packaging-BOM in the item master (links to VS-29), and performance metrics (damage, cost, sustainability); set the pallet/RTI strategy (W3529)

SCM/Finance approve the packaging cost-reduction and sustainability targets (links to W3542/W3526), align to the budget (links to VS-33.1) and commodity outlook (links to VS-106 — corrugate/plastic are commodity-derived), and report to governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Merchandising (links to VS-01), Private Label (links to VS-41), Quality (links to VS-31), Supplier (links to VS-03), Marketing (links to VS-14), Master Data (links to VS-29)
fields.Trigger: New product / private-label development (links to VS-01.1/VS-41); packaging issue

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-test of "test the packaging" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-specification risk**: Inadequate packaging causes damage (links to VS-90/VS-31); mitigated by testing
- **Over-specification risk**: Over-packaging wastes cost/material; mitigated by right-sizing
System Touchpoints: - Item/packaging master & GTIN (links to VS-29/VS-71); quality testing (links to VS-31); merchandising/private label (links to VS-01/VS-41); graphics (links to VS-14)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng specify the product (consumer/unit) packaging per SKU: material (corrugate, blister, clamshell, bag), size/dimensions, weight, protection level, shelf appeal/graphics (links to VS-14), barcoding (links to VS-29/VS-71), and regulatory/labeling (W3527); right-size to minimize waste and cube

Packaging Eng/Quality test the packaging: drop/compression/vibration/shelf-life testing (links to VS-31), transit-simulation (links to W3523), compatibility with the product (chemicals/paint links to VS-24.3), and consumer/ergonomic validation; iterate to spec

Packaging Eng/Master Data load the packaging spec and packaging-BOM (unit pack, inner, master/carton, pallet layer, GTIN hierarchy links to VS-29/VS-71) into the item master, publish to procurement (W3524) and vendors (W3525), and maintain through the product lifecycle (links to VS-01.1)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), Quality (links to VS-31), Supplier
fields.Trigger: Damage analytics (W3540); new lane/mode/product; import packaging

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics design the transport/protective packaging per lane/mode" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate the transport design via transit/damage testing and real damage data" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track damage reduction" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
- operational: transit testing and damage analytics; operational: barrier/desiccant packaging
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transit-damage risk**: Inadequate transport packaging drives claims (links to VS-90); mitigated by transit testing and damage analytics
- **Import-moisture risk**: Ocean-transit moisture damages goods; mitigated by barrier/desiccant packaging
System Touchpoints: - Lane/SKU master (links to VS-29/VS-110); import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); quality (links to VS-31); damage (links to VS-90/W3511/W3540); hazmat (links to VS-24.3)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Logistics design the transport/protective packaging per lane/mode: export/import packaging (container-load, moisture/vapor barrier, desiccant for ocean transit links to VS-02.2/W3503), palletization pattern and stretch-wrap/strapping, corner-boards/edge-protection, dunnage/void-fill, and fragile/hazardous handling (links to VS-24.3); optimize pallet build (W3529) and cube (links to W3541)

Packaging Eng/Quality validate the transport design via transit/damage testing and real damage data (W3540): drop, vibration, compression, humidity, tilt; iterate to reduce damage claims (links to VS-90/W3511) and protect high-value/fragile categories (appliances, tiles, power tools)

Packaging Eng publish the transport-packaging spec to vendors (inbound, W3525) and DC/store (outbound handling), capture the spec in the lane/SKU master (links to VS-29/VS-110), and track damage reduction (W3540) and freight-cube improvement (W3541)

fields.Participants: Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Packaging Eng, SCM, Finance (links to VS-15/VS-17), DC (links to VS-04), Supplier
fields.Volume: Cartons, stretch wrap, dunnage, labels, tape, etc.

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Procurement/Packaging Eng source packaging materials per spec" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-import of "import for specialty materials" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track supplier performance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
- operational: safety stock and dual-sourcing; operational: contracts and indexed pricing (links to VS-106)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Supply-shortage risk**: Packaging-material stockout halts packing/shipping; mitigated by safety stock and dual-sourcing
- **Price-volatility risk**: Corrugate/plastic swings inflate cost; mitigated by contracts and indexed pricing (links to VS-106)
System Touchpoints: - Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); AP (links to VS-15); cost allocation (links to W3528/W3514); inventory (links to VS-05); quality (links to VS-31); supplier scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Procurement/Packaging Eng source packaging materials per spec: cartons/corrugate, stretch-wrap, strapping, labels, tape, void-fill, desiccant, and specialty materials; RFQ/framework agreements (links to VS-03/VS-34 methodology), supplier qualification, and total-cost evaluation (material, lead time, sustainability)

Procurement/Supplier manage supply: forecast packaging-material demand (links to VS-02), place orders/blanket releases (links to VS-03.2), manage lead times and import for specialty materials (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), and ensure quality (links to VS-31); manage price volatility (corrugate/plastic links to VS-106)

Procurement/Finance manage packaging-material AP (links to VS-15), allocate cost to the packaging-BOM/cost object (links to W3528/W3514), track supplier performance (links to VS-67), and feed cost analytics (W3542) and reduction initiatives (W3518); manage packaging-material inventory (links to VS-05)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Quality (links to VS-31), Vendor Management (links to VS-03), Private Label (links to VS-41), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Import (links to VS-02.2/VS-87)
fields.Trigger: New vendor/private-label onboarding (links to VS-03.1/VS-41); packaging issue

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-communication of "communicate BuildRight's packaging requirements to vendors and private-label…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "Quality/Packaging Eng audit vendor/private-label packaging compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track compliance in the vendor scorecard" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
- operational: audit and chargeback; operational: accuracy audit (links to VS-29/VS-71)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-compliance risk**: Vendor packaging damages goods or fails standards; mitigated by audit and chargeback
- **Barcode/label error risk**: Wrong GTIN/label disrupts receiving and POS; mitigated by accuracy audit (links to VS-29/VS-71)
System Touchpoints: - Vendor portal (links to VS-03.4); quality/inspection (links to VS-31.1); private label (links to VS-41); GTIN/barcode (links to VS-29/VS-71); chargeback (links to VS-03/W245); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Vendor Mgmt communicate BuildRight's packaging requirements to vendors and private-label suppliers: product/transport packaging spec (W3522/W3523), palletization and inbound packaging standard (W3534), barcoding/GTIN (links to VS-29/VS-71), labeling/regulatory (W3527), and sustainability/EPR (W3526); include in vendor onboarding (links to VS-03.1) and PO terms
steps.r: Packaging Eng / Vendor Mgmt / Private Label

steps.activity: Quality/Packaging Eng audit vendor/private-label packaging compliance: incoming inspection (links to VS-31.1), packaging-spec conformity, damage-in-transit rate (links to W3540/VS-90), barcoding/labeling accuracy, and pallet/inbound compliance (W3534); manage non-compliance and chargeback (links to VS-03/W245)

Packaging Eng/Private Label manage packaging changes with vendors: spec updates, transition/last-time-buy (links to W1026), sustainability transitions (W3526), and private-label packaging refresh (links to VS-41); track compliance in the vendor scorecard (links to VS-67/W3512)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Sustainability (links to VS-25), Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-41), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Compliance (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Waste Mgmt (links to VS-73)
fields.Trigger: Sustainability plan (links to VS-25); EPR Act RA 11898 / LGU plastic rules

workflows.name: Sustainable Packaging & EPR / Extended Producer Responsibility

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify SKUs for recyclable/biodegradable redesign" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "Sustainability/Compliance manage EPR compliance and reporting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
- operational: compliance program and PRO partnership; operational: business case and phased transition
Pain Points / Risks: - **EPR-non-compliance risk**: Failure to meet EPR/plastic obligations attracts penalties; mitigated by compliance program and PRO partnership
- **Transition-trade-off risk**: Sustainable materials raise cost or reduce performance; mitigated by business case and phased transition
System Touchpoints: - ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25.3); EPR/LGU compliance (links to VS-22/VS-76); circular economy (links to VS-73); legal (links to VS-100.3); packaging data (links to VS-29/VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Sustainability set the sustainable-packaging strategy: recyclable/biodegradable material targets, packaging reduction/right-sizing, recycled-content goals, elimination of problematic single-use plastics (links to W3543), and alignment to the ESG/sustainability plan (links to VS-25.3) and EPR obligations (RA 11898)

Packaging Eng execute material transitions: identify SKUs for recyclable/biodegradable redesign (links to W3522), vendor engagement (W3525), business case and transition plan, and manage trade-offs (cost, performance, shelf-life); coordinate with circular economy (links to VS-73) and recycling/EPR-programs (PRO partnerships)

Sustainability/Compliance manage EPR compliance and reporting: packaging-data collection (material/weight by type), PRO (Producer Responsibility Organization) registration and fees, EPR plan/submission, LGU plastic-ordinance compliance (links to VS-76), and disclosure (links to VS-25.3); audit and report to governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Compliance/Regulatory (links to VS-22), Quality (links to VS-31), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Import/Customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87), Legal (links to VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: Packaging spec (W3522); regulatory change (links to VS-22)
fields.Volume: All SKUs incl. hazmat (paint, chemicals, solvents)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Packaging Eng/Compliance specify required labeling per SKU/category" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate for import" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record for audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: labeling audit; operational: hazmat packaging spec and validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-labeling risk**: Wrong/missing labels breach regulation and cause recall (links to VS-89); mitigated by labeling audit
- **Hazmat-non-compliance risk**: Non-UN packaging for dangerous goods causes incident/penalty; mitigated by hazmat packaging spec and validation
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/permits (links to VS-22/VS-31); hazmat (links to VS-24.3); import/customs (links to VS-02.2/VS-87); recall (links to VS-89); records (links to VS-88); regulatory change (links to VS-22.3)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Compliance specify required labeling per SKU/category: mandatory labels (DTI-BPS/ICC, FDA where applicable, PS Mark links to VS-22/VS-31), product-safety and precautionary labels, country-of-origin, ingredients/chemical (GHS for hazmat links to VS-24.3), and consumer information (Consumer Act RA 7394 links to VS-22)

Packaging Eng/Import ensure hazmat and regulated packaging compliance: UN-certified packaging for dangerous goods (paint, solvents, adhesives links to VS-24.3), hazmat marking/labels/placards, IATA/IMDG/DOT for transport (links to VS-110/W3503 import), and DENR rules (links to VS-73); validate for import (links to VS-87)

Quality/Compliance audit labeling/hazmat compliance on incoming and private-label (links to VS-31/VS-41), manage non-compliance and recalls (links to VS-89), and maintain the compliance record for audit (links to VS-88/VS-22); track regulatory change (links to VS-22.3)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, FP&A (links to VS-17.4), SCM/Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), BI (links to VS-28.1), Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101), Master Data (links to VS-29)

workflows.name: Packaging Cost, Bill of Material & Lifecycle Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify high-cost and over-packaged SKUs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze the packaging cost drivers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track packaging cost-as-%-of-COGS over time" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-562 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Engineering, Specification & Procurement (PA-111.1).)
- operational: packaging-BOM capture; operational: governance and tracked initiatives
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-opacity risk**: Packaging cost hidden in COGS; mitigated by packaging-BOM capture
- **Action-inertia risk**: Analytics not acted on; mitigated by governance and tracked initiatives
System Touchpoints: - Packaging-BOM/item cost (links to VS-29/W3515); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); BI (links to VS-28.1); commodity (links to VS-106); merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/FP&A capture the packaging-BOM cost per SKU (unit/inner/master/pallet packaging material cost) in the item/landed cost (links to VS-29/W3515), and compute total packaging cost by category/vendor/channel; identify high-cost and over-packaged SKUs

Packaging Eng/SCM analyze the packaging cost drivers: material price (links to VS-106 commodity), volume, spec/sizing, damage (W3540), and sustainability premium (W3526); model right-sizing/standardization savings and trade-offs

Packaging Eng/FP&A publish the packaging-cost and lifecycle analytics to executives (links to VS-33.2) and governance (W3544), feed reduction initiatives (W3518) and merchandising decisions (links to VS-01/VS-101), and track packaging cost-as-%-of-COGS over time
